scope: Comments 3, 4, 6, 9, 14, 15, 16: recipe ingredients, exploration and pinned missing basic frontier

validation.command: node --test --test-reporter=tap tests/recipe-navigation-v30.test.mjs tests/crafting-dock.test.mjs tests/catalog-recipes-d006.test.mjs tests/grimoire-display.test.mjs tests/recipe-tree.test.mjs tests/recipe-filters.test.mjs tests/recipe-breakdown.test.mjs tests/ranks-recipes.test.mjs

preservation.readOnlyGameChecks: Real Game snapshots and matched RNG streams cover repeated catalog/dock/history/frontier inspection, all 38 recipes, hidden/reserved/stale/ruin stock, secret current-round eligibility, duplicate leaf counts and actual crafting transitions.
preservation.uiOnlyNavigation: History mutates caller-owned UI state; catalog browsing does not invoke Game actions. Dock exploration actions are integration hooks, separate from guarded Recruit champion actions.
preservation.runtimeAllocation: recipeTreeProgress owns allocation. A ready intermediate champion covers its consumed subtree once; only uncovered basic leaves appear in the missing frontier.
preservation.visualQa: Native browser QA belongs to the parent agent; this proof records source and actual Game tests.
preservation.separatePointerScope: game/render/draft-markers.js is now owned by the same subagent for comment 17; its independent pointer proof is recorded separately. This recipe allowlist remains limited to the eight listed files.

authorizedSeparateScopes.public/release.json: Parent-owned release metadata; approved art and core data remain unchanged.

integration.imports: recipeNavigationVisit, recipeNavigationStep, recipeNavigationModel, pinnedMissingBasicSummary from ui/recipe-navigation.js
integration.dockOptions: Pass {navigation: UIHistoryState} to updateCraftingDock; actions recipe-explore, recipe-history-back and recipe-history-forward.
integration.pinnedGoal: craftingDockModel(...).pinned.missingBasics returns {items,total,summary}; compact summary is basic defender codes, e.g. 2×SII, DI.
integration.catalog: Internal data-catalog-ingredient and data-catalog-history actions preserve search, filters, disclosures and detail focus; existing onDetail stamping callback is retained.

followup: Comment 4 applies abbreviations to all exact ingredient names. Multiword champion names use UI-only English initials (MD I, BFD I, FK I); single-word names use their first three letters (RAN I, CAT I, KIN I, GOL I). Basic runtime defenderCode values and missing frontier shorthand are unchanged.
